rules.name: Visual Studio Build Tools with VC tools
rules.fix_hint: Install Visual Studio Build Tools 2022 with the Desktop development with C++ workload. This tool never installs anything.

rules.name: vcvarsall.bat available
rules.fix_hint: Repair the VC++ build tools workload; vcvarsall.bat should exist under VC\Auxiliary\Build.

rules.name: Windows 10/11 SDK installed
rules.fix_hint: Install the Windows 10/11 SDK with the Desktop C++ workload.

rules.name: Python 3.8+ available for node-gyp
rules.fix_hint: Install Python 3.8+ and ensure the python executable is on PATH.

rules.name: Node.js available
rules.fix_hint: Install Node.js LTS and ensure node is on PATH.

rules.name: npm available
rules.fix_hint: npm ships with Node.js; repair the Node.js installation if it is missing.

rules.name: node-gyp MSVS version compatible
rules.fix_hint: If node-gyp picks the wrong toolset, run: npm config set msvs_version 2022

rules.name: WindowsSdkDir is valid when set
rules.fix_hint: If you set WindowsSdkDir manually, point it at the installed SDK root or unset it and let the registry fallback work.

rules.name: INCLUDE/LIB paths are valid when set
rules.fix_hint: Do not set INCLUDE/LIB globally; run vcvarsall.bat in the same shell instead.

rules.name: cl.exe visibility (informational)
rules.fix_hint: Run the printed vcvarsall.bat line before invoking node-gyp; do not add cl.exe to the global PATH.
